info.description:
Logistics and Manifest Management API for Logitech.

## Demo / Seed Credentials

All seeded staff accounts use PIN `demo1234`. Use `POST /api/auth/login` with `staff_id` + `pin`.

| Staff ID | Full Name      | Role    | Job Role   | PIN      |
|----------|----------------|---------|------------|----------|
| GAL-001  | Chinedu Okafor | owner   | —          | demo1234 |
| GAL-002  | Ada Nwosu      | manager | —          | demo1234 |
| GAL-003  | Tunde Bello    | staff   | operations | demo1234 |
| GAL-004  | Mary James     | staff   | receiving  | demo1234 |

**GAL-014** and **GAL-015** have `first_login_done = false` — they still need an OTP + new PIN (use `POST /api/staff/:id/reset-pin` as an owner/admin to obtain a fresh OTP).

### System Admin
Use `POST /api/auth/admin/login` with:

| Field    | Value             |
|----------|-------------------|
| username | admin             |
| password | adminpassword123  |

The system admin can also log in via the unified `POST /api/auth/login` endpoint by sending `staff_id: "admin"` (or the admin username) together with `password` instead of `pin`.

post.description:
Authenticate as system administrator using credentials configured in environment.

### Demo credentials

| Field    | Value            |
|----------|------------------|
| username | admin            |
| password | adminpassword123 |

Authenticate a staff member using their `staff_id` and `pin`.

### Normal login (PIN already set)
Send `staff_id` + `pin` only.

### First login / after a PIN reset
1. Call this endpoint with `staff_id` + `pin` (the one-time password).
The API responds 400 with `"provide new_pin"` in the error message.
2. Call again with `staff_id` + `pin` (OTP) + `new_pin` (4-10 chars).
The OTP is consumed; `new_pin` becomes the permanent PIN.

Account locks after **3** failed attempts; a branch manager or owner must unlock it.

---
### Seed / demo credentials (PIN = `demo1234` for all)

| staff_id | Full name      | Role    |
|----------|----------------|---------|
| GAL-001  | Chinedu Okafor | owner   |
| GAL-002  | Ada Nwosu      | manager |
| GAL-003  | Tunde Bello    | staff   |
| GAL-004  | Mary James     | staff   |

GAL-014 and GAL-015 have `first_login_done = false` (first-login flow required).
Invalidate the current session token using Redis token revocation.

get.description: Returns a simple greeting message from the Logitech API server.
Retrieve a list of manager accounts. Accessible by the owner (and system admin), optionally filtered by branch.

post.description: Creates a manager account for a branch. Only the owner (or system admin) can manage managers. A staff_id is auto-generated and a one-time password is returned once, to be given to the manager for their first login.

get.description: Returns recent manifests with their item counts, newest first. Staff only ever see manifests they created; managers, owners and the system admin see everyone's. Optionally filter by creator (a staff UUID, or "me") and by statuses (comma-separated).

post.description: Creates a manifest and all of its items in one transaction. When manifest_number is omitted the server generates a unique 5-digit number. When destination_branch_id (the "to" branch) is given, every item is stored with that destination; otherwise each item needs its own destination_branch_id. Sender and receiver customers are matched by phone or created on the fly.
post.summary: Create a manifest with its items

post.description: Creates an owner account. Only the system admin can create owners. A staff_id is auto-generated and a one-time password is returned once, to be given to the owner for their first login.
Saves a captured image into the `photos` folder at the project root.
post.summary: Upload a photo taken with the camera

get.description:
Retrieve a list of staff members. Accessible by system_admin, owner, and manager.
Managers are always limited to the staff of their own assigned branch.

post.description:
Creates a staff member (role: staff) with a required job_role: operations, dispatch or receiving. Accessible to owners and managers only.
- Managers can only create staff in their own branch (branch_id is forced from their token).
- Owners can create staff in any branch.
A staff_id (e.g. GAL-001, prefix configurable via STAFF_ID_PREFIX) is auto-generated, and a one-time password is returned once so the user can log in and choose their personal PIN (max 10 chars).

get.description: Get details for a specific staff member by UUID. Staff can only fetch their own profile; managers only staff in their own branch.

put.description: Update a staff member's details. Managers can only update staff in their own branch; the owner can update anyone. Changing status (e.g. re-activating a revoked account) is owner/system admin only.

delete.description: Revokes a user's access by marking their account inactive. Managers can revoke staff in their own branch; the owner can revoke anyone.

get.description: Reports whether the staff has completed their first login (i.e. created their personal PIN), and when. Staff can query their own status; managers only staff in their own branch; the owner can query anyone.
get.summary: Check if a staff has performed their first login

post.description:
Generates a new one-time password for the user, invalidating their current PIN. The one-time password is returned once and must be given to the user, who uses it at login (with new_pin) to choose a new PIN. Any lockout on the account is cleared.
Managers can reset the PIN of staff in their own branch; the owner can reset any PIN.
Removes the lockout from an account that was locked after 3 failed login attempts. Managers can unlock staff of their own branch; the owner can unlock accounts across all branches.

get.description: Returns the service status and PostgreSQL database connection state.

job_role.description: JobRole is required and must be one of operations, dispatch, receiving.

first_login_at.description: FirstLoginAt is set once the user has completed first login (RFC3339).

new_pin.description: NewPin is required on first login (and after a PIN reset) to create the personal PIN.

job_role.description: JobRole may be changed only for staff members; manager/owner accounts have none.

status.description: Status: "active" re-grants access (e.g. after a revoke); owner/system admin only.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and your JWT token.
